description: The engine guide — MANDATORY reading before building. No args = the CORE contracts (WGSL, hooks, fields, the eye) + an INDEX of every capability (films/cutscenes, GPU solvers, multiplayer, audio, components, …). Call again with {section} the moment a task touches an indexed capability — each section is the full working recipe.

section.description: Capability/section name from the index (fuzzy match), e.g. "films", "audio", "swarm"

name: read_guide
